_about: Private disclosure notices sent to the maintainers of servers in the MCP Security Index, keyed by index slug. The 90-day clock in docs/disclosure-policy.md starts at notified_at; a server with findings and no entry here stays withheld. This file is public: never record rule IDs, email addresses or advisory URLs in it. Entry shape: {"notified_at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "channel": "private-advisory" | "security-md" | "email", "reminders": ["YYYY-MM-DD"], "fixed_at": null | "YYYY-MM-DD"}.
